abstract: This paper compares the statistical and economic performance of state‐of‐the‐art high‐frequency (HF) based multivariate volatility models with a simpler, widely used alternative, the Exponentially Weighted Moving Average (EWMA) filter. Using over two decades of 100 U.S. stock returns (2002–2023), we assess model performance through a Global Minimum Variance portfolio optimization exercise, with and without short‐selling restrictions across multiple forecast horizons. We find that the EWMA model cannot consistently be outperformed by more complex HF‐based volatility models at the daily and weekly forecast horizons, even delivering significant utility gains when including transaction costs due to a favorable balance between turnover and ex‐post portfolio volatility. At the monthly horizon, the EWMA remains competitive against most of its competitors. Our findings hold across alternative specifications, including different estimation window lengths, portfolio sizes and smoothing parameter values, emphasizing the continued relevance of parsimonious volatility specifications, such as the EWMA model, in realistic investment settings.
abstract_zh: 本文对比了基于高频数据的先进多元波动率模型与一种更简单且广泛使用的替代模型——指数加权移动平均（EWMA）滤波器的统计及经济表现。利用2002年至2023年间超过二十年的100只美国股票回报数据，我们通过全球最小方差投资组合优化练习评估模型表现，涵盖多个预测期限，并考虑有无卖空限制的情况。研究发现，在日度和周度预测期限上，EWMA模型无法被更复杂的高频波动率模型持续超越，甚至在考虑交易成本时，由于换手率与事后投资组合波动性之间的有利平衡，能带来显著的效用增益。在月度期限上，EWMA模型仍能与大多数竞争对手保持竞争力。我们的结论在不同规格下均成立，包括不同的估计窗口长度、投资组合规模和平滑参数值，强调了在现实投资环境中，如EWMA模型这类简约波动率规格的持续相关性。
title: Revisiting EWMA in High‐Frequency‐Based Portfolio Optimization: A Comparative Assessment
title_zh: 基于高频数据的EWMA投资组合优化再探讨：一项比较评估

abstract: We examine the lasting impact of Cold War alignment on African development. To overcome the empirical challenge of ambiguous and interdependent international alliances during the Cold War, we introduce a non-cooperative game of social interactions. Using pre-determined, country-level characteristics to construct payoffs, we identify a unique two-bloc equilibrium partition of the continent. We then assign bloc alignments based on how the partition predicts UN voting patterns. Our empirical results indicate no income differences today between the Western and the Eastern blocs. However, their development paths reflect Cold War ideologies: Western-aligned African countries have greater inequality, financial development, and democracy, but lesser infrastructure, compared to Eastern-aligned ones.
abstract_zh: 我们考察了冷战时期阵营归属对非洲发展的持久影响。为克服冷战期间国际联盟模糊且相互依存的实证挑战，我们引入了一个非合作的社会互动博弈模型。利用预先确定的国别层面特征来构建收益，我们识别出非洲大陆一个独特的双阵营均衡划分。随后，我们根据该划分对联合国投票模式的预测来分配阵营归属。实证结果显示，今日西方阵营与东方阵营之间的收入并无差异。然而，它们的发展路径反映了冷战意识形态：与东方阵营相比，西方阵营的非洲国家不平等程度更高、金融发展更深入、民主程度更高，但基础设施相对薄弱。
title: Did the Cold War produce development clusters in Africa?
title_zh: 冷战是否在非洲催生了发展集群？

abstract: We introduce public-good auctions, a versatile framework addressing auction scenarios where players benefit not only from winning themselves but also when their competitors win. Distinct from private-good auctions, public-good auctions feature prizes as public goods enjoyed by all players and allow them to choose from multiple prizes. Demonstrating broad applicability, public-good auctions can be applied to various economic models, including auctions with externalities, and combinatorial auctions. The framework effectively explains unconventional situations marked by conflicting incentives between cooperation and competition and diverse behaviors, such as free-riding, cooperation, strategic voting, and multiple targeting, which are unobserved in traditional auction settings. Using a two-player model, we present four main results regarding the existence, characterization, and uniqueness of equilibrium payoffs.
abstract_zh: 我们引入公共品拍卖这一通用框架，用以处理拍卖场景中玩家不仅从自身获胜中获益，还从竞争对手获胜中获益的情形。与私人物品拍卖不同，公共品拍卖的特点在于奖品作为公共品为所有玩家所共享，且玩家可选择多个奖品。该框架展现出广泛的适用性，可应用于多种经济模型，包括具有外部性的拍卖和组合拍卖。此框架有效解释了传统拍卖环境中未观察到的、以合作与竞争之间激励冲突为标志的非常规情境及多样化行为，如搭便车、合作、策略性投票和多重目标设定。通过一个双玩家模型，我们提出了关于均衡收益的存在性、特征化及唯一性的四项主要结果。
title: Bidding for public goods

abstract: We use long-run annual cross-country data for 10 macroeconomic variables to evaluate the long-horizon forecast distributions of six forecasting models. The variables we use range from ones having little serial correlation to ones having persistence consistent with unit roots. Our forecasting models include simple time series models and frequency domain models developed in Müller and Watson (2016). For plausibly stationary variables, an AR(1) model and a frequency domain model that does not require the user to take a stand on the order of integration appear reasonably well calibrated for forecast horizons of 10 and 25 years. For plausibly non-stationary variables, a random walk model appears reasonably well calibrated for forecast horizons of 10 and 25 years.
abstract_zh: 我们利用10个宏观经济变量的长期年度跨国数据，评估了六种预测模型在长预测期下的分布预测表现。所采用的变量范围从序列相关性极低到具有单位根一致性的持续性不等。我们的预测模型包括简单时间序列模型以及Müller和Watson（2016）提出的频域模型。对于可能平稳的变量，AR(1)模型和一种无需用户对积分阶数做出明确假设的频域模型，在10年和25年的预测期下，校准效果表现合理。对于可能非平稳的变量，随机游走模型在10年和25年的预测期下，校准效果同样表现合理。
title: An empirical evaluation of some long-horizon macroeconomic forecasts
title_zh: 一些长期宏观经济预测的实证评估
